evals.name: extract-refunds
evals.prompt: Refunds are getting complicated enough that they deserve their own module. Pull the refund logic out of orders into a new shop/refunds module and update whatever uses it. Keep the tests passing.
evals.expected_output: Creates shop/refunds with refund_order in its public API, implemented against the orders module's public interface. Callers such as support use shop.refunds. Orders no longer implements or re-exports refunds, so there is no orders<->refunds cycle, and nothing imports another module's internal package.

assertions.text: shop.refunds owns refund_order and refund behavior is preserved
No module imports another module's internals, modules form no import cycle, and tests pass
No new shared grab-bag module (utils, common, core, ...) was added

evals.name: fix-cycle
evals.prompt: lint-imports in CI started failing with 'Modules do not import each other in a cycle' — shop.orders and shop.billing. The app itself works fine. Can you fix it so CI goes green?
evals.expected_output: Removes the dependency in one direction, for example by having billing notify orders through a callback or by moving payment-state ownership to one side, so neither module imports the other in a cycle. Does not just move the import inside a function, which leaves the dependency cycle in place.

assertions.text: No module imports another module's internals, modules form no import cycle (including imports inside functions), and tests pass
The cycle is not broken by moving both modules' state into a new shared module (utils, common, core, ...)

evals.name: shared-formatting
evals.prompt: The order confirmation text should also show the order total, formatted the same way invoices format money. Update confirmation_text in orders. Add a test.
evals.expected_output: Shows the formatted total in the confirmation by using a function billing exports through its public API, or by a small local helper. Does not import billing's internal money module and does not create a shared utils/common package.

assertions.text: No shared grab-bag module was added and the confirmation shows the formatted total
No module imports another module's internals, modules form no import cycle, and tests pass

assertions.text: shop.refunds owns refund_order and refund behavior is preserved

assertions.text: No module imports another module's internals, modules form no import cycle (including imports inside functions), and tests pass
